description.value: SHED is a casual, family-friendly restaurant in the heart of downtown Tofino, celebrated for its burgers, bowls, and brews made with locally sourced ingredients from Vancouver Island farms and waters. The space features both a patio and indoor dining, with a separate late-night menu running until midnight. It draws on a warm west coast vibe and operates on a first-come, first-served basis with no reservations required.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (20 spaces, covered) at 13m; stands (2 spaces) at 45m; stands (4 spaces) at 50m; stands (6 spaces) at 52m. Total: 32 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and is the primary evidence source. The site confirms the address (461 Campbell Street, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0), phone (250 725 7433), and that the business is an active restaurant offering patio, indoor dining, and take-out. The menu explicitly lists gluten-free bun substitutions and multiple vegetarian/plant-based options (Attenburger, Aphrodite, Mayan Picnic bowl), and the homepage mentions 'take-out available.' No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging anywhere in the site content. OSM name is 'The Shed' but the website consistently uses 'SHED' or 'Shed Tofino' — flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM name is 'The Shed' but the website consistently uses 'SHED' or 'Shed Tofino' — possible branding discrepancy or OSM name inaccuracy.
OSM record has no phone number; phone sourced from website only so contact_confirmed.phone is unverifiable against OSM.
Homepage mentions 'STAGE 1 WATER CONSERVATION' — may indicate restrictions on water service, but no explicit information about water bottle refills.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant in downtown Tofino with confirmed contact details and a current menu. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a meal or takeout.
enrichment_extras.notes: No dogs permitted per website: 'While we love dogs, our space isn't set up to accommodate them' — relevant for cycle tourists travelling with pets.
